title: 3 Rock mountain
html_source:
Three Rock Mountain is a mountain in Co Dublin, Ireland. It is 444 metres (1,457 feet) high. The Rock of Gibralter is is 426 m (1,398 ft) high but more imposing due to its location.

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three_Rock
